facts.fact: A survey cited by StackAdapt found that 78% of marketing decision-makers believe at least 10% of spend is wasted due to insufficient measurement (third-party eMarketer survey).
facts.quote: 78% of marketing decision-makers believe at least 10% of spend is wasted due to insufficient measurement.

facts.fact: In StackAdapt's own analysis of approximately 5 million StackAdapt-influenced conversion paths, 52.5% of conversion journeys spanned multiple channels.
facts.quote: 52.5% of conversion journeys spanned multiple channels.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's analysis of conversion paths covered approximately 5 million StackAdapt-influenced conversion paths.
StackAdapt published the last-touch attribution blog article on June 17, 2026.
StackAdapt states that last-touch reporting can still help teams understand the final interaction before conversion.
facts.quote: Last-touch reporting can still help teams understand the final interaction before conversion.
